svg.aria-label: 2 panels, each showing a matrix of 4 rows and 8 columns of floats, numbered by address in row-major order, and the same 32 floats laid out in memory as 4 sectors of 8. Top: 8 lanes read row 1, elements 8 to 15, which fill sector 1 exactly: 1 sector fetched, 32 bytes, all used. Bottom: 4 lanes read column 5, elements 5, 13, 21 and 29, which lie 8 floats apart in 4 different sectors: 4 sectors fetched, 128 bytes, for 16 useful bytes.
svg.text: A row and a column of the same matrix
Neighbours in a row are neighbours in memory; neighbours in a column are 8 floats apart.
each number is the element's address
the same 32 floats in memory, as 4 sectors of 8 floats
1 sector fetched: 32 bytes for 32 useful bytes
